Resolve an authenticated session to the current server-owned actor.

Source: R/curation_auth.R
curation_auth_resolve_session.Rd

Resolve an authenticated session to the current server-owned actor.

Usage

curation_auth_resolve_session(
  auth,
  session_token,
  timestamp = Sys.time(),
  touch = TRUE
)

curation_auth_resolve_actor(
  auth,
  session_token,
  timestamp = Sys.time(),
  touch = TRUE
)

Arguments

auth

A store from curation_auth_open().

session_token

The opaque handle returned by authentication.

timestamp

Current POSIXct or epoch seconds.

touch

Update the idle timestamp. Set to FALSE for a reverse-proxy validity probe; protected app requests should use TRUE.

Value

A planscanR_curation_actor, or NULL for an invalid/expired session.
